name: Switch xdist to --dist=loadgroup with session-scoped store
description: Test-suite speedup: pytest-xdist moved from loadfile to loadgroup, connected_store fixture promoted to session scope, xdist_group markers added to MCP and install test files, docs updated, wall time measured (target missed).
effort: Small config change touching one fixture, pytest options and a batch of test files via one-line markers. No storage, services or migrations. Risk is test isolation (sys.modules stubs, install lock race) and repeated full-suite runs for stability and timing.
